QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] I Am the Council President
QuestInfo.0: #b#m310000000##k's new Council President #b#p2152007##k gave you an order.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2152007# says everyone started hating him once he became the new Council President. He says they gossip about him and that they need to be watched. He asks that you bring #b#t4000604##k from #r#o2150003##k...

#i4000604# #t4000604# #b#c4000604#/60#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2152007# said he can keep an eye out for people who gossip about him using the #t4000604#.

0.0: Why, hello there. I'm not sure if we've met. We may have. Then again, we might not have. As Council President of #m310000000# I just meet so very many people...
0.1: In my time as Council President, I've come to realize #m310000000#'s biggest problem... The people here don't comprehend my great talents! In fact, some of them are outright criticizing me! A truly regretful situation.
0.2: It all comes down to a lack of effort on my part. So I have a plan, a plan to listen to the residents. Will you help?

yes.0: It's really simple. Since the #r#o2150003#s#k are able to record people's conversation, I need you to get the #b#t4000604#s#k from them. About #b60#k should do. And think of this more as a public opinion survey and not wiretapping...

no.0: What? How dare you disobey the President of the Council! We don't need people like you in #m310000000#! You are hereby expelled! Expelled, I say!

1.0: Have you brought the #t4000604# items? Ah, thank you. I will now listen to the voice of the people. And I'll arrest anyone who speaks poorly of me...! Ahem, never mind.

item.0: Have you not been able to get the #b60 #t4000604##k items yet? I heard that the #r#o2150003#s#k are constantly recording people's conversations...
